name: Luồng 3 - AI-Driven Ticket Generation & SLA Dispatcher (12 Nodes)

parameters.query: SELECT id, full_name, name, email, active_tickets_count FROM support_agents WHERE (status = 'AVAILABLE' OR is_active = true) AND (category = 'Technical' OR category IS NULL) ORDER BY active_tickets_count ASC;

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({
  ticket_code: $json.ticket_code,
  customer_email: $json.customer_email,
  sender_email: $json.sender_email,
  subject: $json.title,
  title: $json.title,
  description: $json.description,
  summary: $json.technical_summary,
  category: $json.category,
  priority: $json.priority,
  status: "PENDING",
  assigned_to: $json.assigned_to,
  agent_email: $json.agent_email,
  assigned_agent_id: $json.assigned_agent_id,
  affected_module: $json.affected_module,
  reproduce_steps: $json.reproduce_steps
}) }}

parameters.query: UPDATE support_agents SET active_tickets_count = active_tickets_count + 1 WHERE email = $1 OR id = $2;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$('5. Least-Busy Load Balancer Code').first().json.agent_email, $('5. Least-Busy Load Balancer Code').first().json.assigned_agent_id] }}

parameters.query: INSERT INTO system_audit_logs (source, event_type, workflow_id, description, payload, payload_snapshot) VALUES ('m1-flow3', 'TICKET_DISPATCHED_TO_AGENT', 'flow03_ticket_sla_dispatch', 'Vé sự cố kỹ thuật đã được phân phối tự động cho KTV và kích hoạt SLA', $1::jsonb, $1::jsonb);
